text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list, 
 to be performed on an (1/2) annually bases as indicated by M6 in the above title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed 
 Hussein Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanical & electrical after cooling the unit
Stop the A.P.H mother
Isolate the fuels systems and all valves (delivery & suction)
Open the drain valves for (all boiler parts)
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit (spanners & 
 wrenches)
Screw drivers &
 gear pullers ... etc
Lubricating oil & general purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Amyant rope
Allen keys
Welding equipment
Cutting & milling machines
Adobes & cement
Work to be 
carried out
Check external body and flexible joints
Check the valves of fuels
Check the bearge circle
Check the leakage
Check the heating system piping
Check the burners tip (disk -imppler - and all parts)
Check the gates of forwarded air
Assembling the element
Adjusting
Check after repairing
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective unites
Remove the insulation
Check external body and flexible joints
Check the valves of fuels
Check the bearge circle
Check the leakage
Check the heating system piping
Check the burners tip (disk -imppler - and all parts)
Check the gates of forwarded air
Assembling the element
Adjusting
Check after repairing
Restore all valves to the operating normal position
Clean the area after repairing
